description.value: Mükasi Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Chilliwack offering a curated selection of single-origin beans from Ethiopia, Guatemala, Honduras, Vietnam, and beyond, alongside carefully crafted house blends. The business is notably focused on traceability and quality, providing detailed sourcing and cupping notes for each coffee. A touring cyclist stopping in can explore an independently operated roaster with an e-commerce presence and local delivery, rather than a conventional chain café.

address.value: 32900 South Fraser Way, Unit 303, Chilliwack, BC V2S 5A1

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 12m; rack (3 spaces) at 49m; rack (3 spaces) at 78m. Total: 9 spaces.
